name: Raymarched 2.5D cast and drop shadows with dither filtering
description: Verify drawing a solid colored circular ball, rendering raymarched ground cast shadows, switching between Directional Cast and Ground Drop styles, and applying ordered Bayer dither patterns.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select a vibrant color, and click inside the circle to color it solidly
Verify a solid colored circular ball is clearly visible in the center canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 'Raymarched Soft Shadows' panel is displayed
Verify a dedicated 'Cast Shadow' layer is generated beneath the colored ball with raymarched ground contact projection
Click the 'Ground Drop (Oval)' style toggle button, then click 'Analyze & Cast Shadow' again
Verify the shadow layer updates in-place to render an oval drop shadow contact patch beneath the ball
